title: Register for Pediatric Patients With Antiphospholipid Syndrome (APS): European Project Extended Internationally Study
official: Register for Pediatric Patients With Antiphospholipid Syndrome (APS): European Project Extended Internationally Study
summary: The purpose of this study is to gather information about causes and treatment of Antiphospholipid Syndrome.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age or younger at the onset of disease
* Presence of Vascular Thrombosis
* UC Davis patient
* Presence of at least one Laboratory criteria including: Anticardiolipin antibody, Anti-B glycoprotein-I antibody or Lupus anticoagulant in plasma

Exclusion Criteria:

* Infants born to mothers with APS
* Infants with congenital thrombophilia
